classification.difficultyReason: Identify opposite rays at an intersection and name the vertically opposite angle, including intersections within larger figures.

content.prompt: Name the angle that is vertically opposite to $\angle PQR$ in each diagram below.

spec.description: Two straight lines PS and TR intersect at Q. Ordinary source-blue strokes are reconstructed in house black.
spec.mathematics: QP and QS are opposite rays; QR and QT are opposite rays.
spec.answerVisibility: Point labels and both intersecting lines are permanent givens; no answer is shown.

answer.worked: $QP$ and $QS$ are opposite rays, and $QR$ and $QT$ are opposite rays. Therefore $\angle SQT$ is vertically opposite to $\angle PQR$.

spec.mathematics: QP and QV are opposite rays; QR and QU are opposite rays.
spec.answerVisibility: All point labels and both lines are supplied; no answer is shown.

answer.worked: $QP$ and $QV$ are opposite rays, and $QR$ and $QU$ are opposite rays. Therefore $\angle VQU$ is vertically opposite to $\angle PQR$.
